question.text: During a DRAWDOWN (market falling 20%), a 60/40 portfolio drifts to 50/50 (equity declined). Rebalancing into equity:

answer.text: Enforces 'buy low' discipline by adding to equity after declines

explanation.text: The Logic: Rebalancing to target during declines = adding to equity when cheap. Contrarian discipline. The Trap: Feels uncomfortable to buy during falls; rebalancing removes emotion. Cross-Exam Context: Core PM. Manager's Pro-Tip: Clients often resist drawdown rebalancing — pre-commit in IPS to make it automatic.
